title: FloorEvent
description: Payload of a sensor floor event in the session log (B3), validated before it is appended. `kind` equals the event's `type`; the writer checks that relation. The floor is Ring 0 (06 Ring 0 contents): a deterministic rule table on the host compares the candidate tree with the run's base commit, and a candidate cannot pass by adding a suppression, changing config discovery, replacing a test command or deleting a protected assertion.

checked.title: FloorChecked
checked.description: The floor checked the candidate tree. `verdict` is `reject` if and only if there is at least one finding; `truncated` is true when more findings were found than are listed.

rules.description: The rule table version, such as `floor-1`.

candidateTree.description: The candidate tree: the worktree's HEAD plus its working tree, without ignored files. Its objects need not be kept; the same content gives the same ID.

findings.description: The findings, sorted by path, line, rule and detail.

finding.title: FloorFinding
finding.description: One rule that fired. `path` is absent only for a `floor.limits` finding about the whole change list; `line` is the 1-based line in the candidate file.

rule.title: FloorRule
rule.description: Rules of `floor-1` and `floor-2`. `assertion.removed` is `floor-1` only: `floor-2` replaces it with `protected.changed`, a finding for any change to a protected path. `floor.limits`: the change was too large to check, so the floor fails closed.

oid.description: A full lowercase hex git object ID (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

path.description: A repo-relative path escaped for display: 1 to 8192 code points without C0 or C1 controls, format characters, line or paragraph separators or lone surrogates, not absolute and without empty, `.` or `..` segments.

text.description: Escaped display text: 1 to 8192 code points without C0 or C1 controls, format characters, line or paragraph separators or lone surrogates.
